tasks.short: Design and direct environmental studies for planned projects

steps.what: Design studies by defining environmental questions, evidence needs, methods and representative investigation conditions
Direct technical investigations, clarify emerging findings and adapt study activity to obtain useful environmental information

tasks.design: Retain study design and scientific direction with the scientist, using {DOCS} for the design and {PROJECT} for agreed investigation activity. The scientist judges what evidence is needed and adapts direction when investigations reveal new uncertainty.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful study design depends on site-specific environmental questions and what observations can answer them.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing planning tools organise activity, but the supplied digest does not establish reduced scientific design or direction time.
tasks.still_hard: A well-organised study can still fail to observe the conditions that matter for a proposed project.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist identifies evidence gaps and recognises when emerging findings require a different investigation.
tasks.altitude: Scientific direction and study responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain project decisions that the environmental study must inform

evidence.claim: Retaining scientific study design and direction is a model-knowledge boundary; general environmental reporting tools do not establish savings in deciding what evidence to obtain.

assumptions: Boundary is study design and direction, not field-team data collection or later report formatting. If choosing collection methods is the same action counted in task 1522, the roll-up assigns it once.
Project staff provide the planned project and site specialists provide existing evidence. The scientist captures research questions, study limits and methods in fully counted s1.

Field teams produce emerging observations during investigations after s2 direction begins; the scientist's enquiries, interpretation and revised instructions remain in s2. No pre-existing sufficient-evidence flag is assumed.
Missing or contradictory evidence requires manual scientific review. Test existing planning functions before custom code; this proposal adds no new tool.
No new data contract or automation is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero and existing planning runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Project decisions the study must support
research_questions: Which study decisions require site-specific scientific judgement rather than reuse of a standard template?

already_counted.description: Scientific study design and ongoing technical direction

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and incremental=0. Study design and scientific direction retain full time; separate planning paperwork is not invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine data collection methods for environmental research

steps.what: Determine data collection methods by assessing research questions, representativeness, uncertainty and practical survey constraints

tasks.design: Keep method selection with the scientist using evidence and method references in {DOCS}. The scientist determines what observations can answer the question, rather than accepting a generated sampling plan as adequate.
tasks.previous_blocker: A collection method must match the environmental mechanism, variability and decision the research addresses.
tasks.enabler_now: Reference material is easier to organise, but the supplied digest does not demonstrate a saving in deciding the appropriate method.
tasks.still_hard: Convenient measurements may systematically miss important places, periods or exposure conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises selection bias and designs collection that can support a defensible conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Method-selection effort and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess whether a proposed collection method is practical at the site

evidence.claim: Retaining context-sensitive collection-method selection is a model-knowledge boundary; data-platform capability does not establish a valid study method or labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is choosing and specifying the collection method, not collection itself. If this is included in a larger study-design action, count it once rather than adding task 1531 again.

Research sponsors and site staff provide the question and constraints; the scientist captures and interprets population, spatial and temporal scope, measurement limits and required uncertainty during fully counted s1.
No structured representative-sample or suitable-method flag is presumed. Missing information leads to manual enquiries, feasibility checks or method revision.
Test existing reference and planning functions before custom code; this proposal introduces no new tool.
No new automation, integration or additional capture requirement is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
research_questions: Which proposed methods would systematically miss relevant environmental variability?

already_counted.description: Method assessment, feasibility enquiries and specification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net zero with zero added upkeep. Scientific collection-method selection remains fully counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct applied environmental research with repeatable numerical analyses

steps.what: Define applied research questions and verify observations, treatment conditions and analysis assumptions
Prepare repeated numerical analyses comparing specified waste treatment or pollution abatement scenarios
Conduct further investigation, challenge explanations and interpret the environmental significance of the research findings

tasks.design: Configure repeatable numerical analysis in {SPREADSHEET} or an {OTHER} environmental analysis system from a dataset and specification checked by the scientist. Retain research design, observations, further investigation and interpretation; a calculated scenario is evidence for examination rather than a research conclusion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated calculation preparation consumed time between collecting evidence and interpreting alternative treatment scenarios.
tasks.enabler_now: Native analytical templates can rerun explicit calculations while keeping source values and assumptions visible.
tasks.still_hard: Treatment effectiveness may depend on unmeasured conditions or an incorrect model of the environmental process.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist distinguishes an informative numerical result from an unsupported causal claim.
tasks.altitude: Repeated calculation preparation may fall; research and interpretation responsibilities stay the same.

reach.task: Check whether treatment scenarios represent realistic operating conditions

evidence.claim: SimaPro supports parameterised environmental life-cycle models and report refresh; this supports a possible analysis subtype, not all applied research or measured scientist savings.
The proposed reduction concerns repeated manual calculation preparation and is an unmeasured model-knowledge assumption.

assumptions: Boundary is applied research including its repeated numerical analyses, not policy approval or treatment deployment. Qualitative or novel research without repeatable calculations has no such saving.

Existing studies provide initial evidence; laboratory and field staff and the scientist produce observations during s1. In fully retained s1 the scientist captures sample id, method, units, conditions, observation time, source version, scenario parameters and calculation definitions.

s2 runs only after s1 supplies checked data and an analysis specification. No ready treatment-effective or valid-scenario flag is presumed; gaps or inconsistent units return to manual capture and investigation.

Additional experiments and their observations arise during s3 investigation and are interpreted there; they are not assumed available for the first s2 run. New analysis requires another checked-data cycle.

Test native analytical configuration before custom code. OTHER denotes environmental analysis software; existing solver runtime earns no labour saving. Upkeep and collaborator clarification are explicitly counted.
unknowns: Presence of repeated manually prepared analyses
Applicability of life-cycle versus other analysis methods
research_questions: Which repeated numerical preparation can be configured without hiding assumptions or changing interpretation effort?

already_counted.description: Capture and check research data and analysis assumptions

incremental.description: Maintain analysis templates and verify changed data mappings
Field or laboratory colleagues clarify changed observations

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross 20 minus 8 focal upkeep gives central net 12. Range covers research without repeated manual calculations and limited template reuse; observation and scientific interpretation retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop land-use programmes from checked spatial evidence

steps.what: Establish land-use objectives and verify site evidence, spatial layers and environmental constraints
Prepare repeatable maps and area comparisons for specified land-use alternatives
Develop programs balancing productive land use, ecological limits and uncertain environmental effects

tasks.design: Configure map overlays and area comparisons in the {OTHER} geospatial analysis environment from scientist-checked sources. Keep programme design in {DOCS}, with the scientist interpreting ecological limits and productive-use trade-offs rather than accepting a numerical non-damaging label.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated map preparation could consume time before the scientist considered the implications of land-use alternatives.
tasks.enabler_now: Native spatial analysis can rerun specified overlays and measurements from versioned data.
tasks.still_hard: Maps may omit ecological interactions, seasonal effects and land-management realities.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist judges where evidence is insufficient to claim that a land use avoids damage.
tasks.altitude: Map preparation may require less effort; environmental judgement and programme recommendations remain human.

reach.task: Connect environmental evidence with feasible management alternatives
reach.learn: Spatial evidence limits and practical land-use constraints

evidence.claim: Copernicus Data Space supports rerunnable geospatial analysis over Earth observation data; this supports data processing, not a conclusion that a land use is harmless.
Configured map comparison preparation and its labour assumptions are model-knowledge proposals without a measured local case.

assumptions: Boundary is spatial evidence preparation and programme proposal, not landowner agreement, permitting or implementation.

Spatial data providers produce source layers and site teams provide observations. In fully retained s1 the scientist captures layer id, date, coordinate reference, resolution, boundaries, proposed use, measurement rules and known gaps.

s2 uses only the checked dataset and comparison specification. No ready non-damaging or suitable-land flag is presumed; missing layers and inconsistent boundaries return to manual preparation and enquiry in s1.
Test native geospatial configuration before custom code. OTHER denotes geospatial analysis software. Existing map service runtime earns no labour saving.
New programme reasoning, stakeholder discussion and environmental interpretation retain full time; mapping upkeep and source clarification are separately counted.
unknowns: Availability and fitness of spatial layers
Whether map comparisons are already configured
research_questions: Can native overlays reduce repeated preparation while exposing spatial gaps and resolution limits?

already_counted.description: Check spatial sources and capture comparison rules
Interpret environmental trade-offs and develop the programme

incremental.description: Maintain spatial mappings and comparison settings
Site or data colleagues clarify changed source layers

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross 20 minus 7 focal upkeep gives central net 13. Range covers already-configured maps and modest repeated overlay preparation; environmental programme reasoning remains full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeatable calculation and map preparation may fall; study design, collection-method selection and environmental interpretation retain human responsibility.
reach: Work with field staff on representative evidence
Work with planners on spatial uncertainty
role.ambitious_version: A scientist who distinguishes reproducible processing from a justified environmental conclusion.

job.title: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
